strings.str.carving.text: Three tools keep the mine alive. First the pick bites the stone. Then the cart bears it away. Last the fire makes it fit to keep. Do the work in its order and the store will open.
strings.str.use.step_1: The pick rack rattles. Something in the wall clicks once.
strings.str.use.step_2: The cart rolls a short way and stops. A second click.
strings.str.use.solved: The furnace flares. A bolt slides back in the storeroom door and it swings loose.
strings.str.use.wrong: A grinding noise. The clicks fall back and the controls go quiet. Nothing is harmed.
strings.str.use.inert: It no longer responds. The storeroom door is open.
strings.str.log.door_other: The storeroom door is open. The controls are idle.
